grants.title: National Science Foundation (America’s Seed Fund)
grants.description: Distributes approximately $200 million annually to startups and small businesses focused on scientific and engineering innovations.

grants.title: SBIR Topics
grants.description: Search active Small Business Innovation Research and STTR funding solicitations across federal agencies.

grants.title: Burroughs Wellcome Fund Climate Change and Human Health Seed Grants
grants.description: Seed grants supporting early-stage research into climate change’s impact on human health.

grants.title: Secretsos Grant
grants.description: A quarterly micro-grant open to entrepreneurs of any industry.

grants.title: NASE Growth Grant
grants.description: Growth grant available to members of the National Association for the Self-Employed.

grants.title: Verizon Small Business Digital Ready
grants.description: Complete 2 free courses to unlock a $10,000 grant application; 10 businesses selected monthly through Dec 2026, via Verizon’s partner LISC.

grants.title: Skip $1,000 Instant Grants
grants.description: These grants provide immediate financial support to small businesses to help with operational costs or growth initiatives.

grants.title: Skip $10,000 Grants
grants.description: A monthly grant program designed to provide significant capital to small businesses for various growth and operational needs.

grants.title: NIH Small Business Research Grants
grants.description: The National Institutes of Health provides funding for small businesses engaged in biomedical technology research and development, including projects related to COVID-19.
grants.best_for: Small businesses focused on biomedical research and development.

grants.title: EDA Investment Assistance
grants.description: The Economic Development Administration provides rolling-basis investments for projects in construction, planning, technical assistance, and research to support regional economic development.
grants.best_for: Businesses and organizations involved in regional economic development and infrastructure projects.

grants.title: SBA STEP Grants
grants.description: The State Trade Expansion Program (STEP) provides financial awards to state and territory governments to assist small businesses with export development.
grants.best_for: Small businesses looking to expand into international markets.

grants.title: Mental Health Cultural Community Continuing Education Grant
grants.description: This grant funds continuing education for trainers focused on mental health within cultural communities in Minnesota.

grants.title: Primary Care Residency Expansion Grant
grants.description: This grant supports the expansion of primary care residency programs to increase the number of trained medical professionals in Minnesota.
grants.best_for: Clinical training programs and hospitals in Minnesota

grants.title: Service Provider and Producer Association Grant
grants.description: This grant funds producer associations or service providers that work with farm or forest product businesses in Vermont.
grants.best_for: Vermont-based producer associations and service providers

grants.title: Somerset Hills Community Health Foundation Grant
grants.description: This grant funds projects and programs that promote healthier individuals and communities in Morris and Somerset counties, New Jersey.
grants.best_for: Organizations promoting community health in New Jersey

grants.title: NVRH Community Health Fund
grants.description: This fund supports community health initiatives in the region served by the Northeastern Vermont Regional Hospital.

grants.title: Restaurant Accelerator and Community Fund Grant
grants.description: This grant provides financial support to restaurant businesses to help with operational growth and community impact.

grants.title: Working Lands Enterprise Initiative (WLEI) Business Enhancement Grant
grants.description: This grant funds projects for farm, forest product, and local food businesses to support growth and development. Projects are designed to start in the spring of 2027.
grants.best_for: Farm, forest product, and local food businesses in Vermont.

grants.title: UArctic Entrepreneurship Fund
grants.description: A seed grant program supporting individuals with Arctic innovations, managed as part of the UArctic Thematic Network on Managing Small and Medium Sized Enterprises in the North.

grants.title: Mississippi Arts Commission Project Grants
grants.description: Provides funding for specific arts-related projects that benefit the community and support local creative businesses or organizations.
grants.best_for: Arts-based small businesses and nonprofits in Mississippi.

grants.title: Mississippi Arts Commission Mini-Grants
grants.description: Smaller scale funding designed to support specific arts projects or capacity-building efforts for organizations and small businesses.
grants.best_for: Small businesses and organizations involved in the arts in Mississippi.

grants.title: Homeland Security Emergency Operations Center Grants
grants.description: Funding provided to support the operational capabilities and infrastructure of emergency centers, which can include support for relevant small business contractors.
grants.best_for: Businesses and organizations involved in emergency operations and infrastructure.

grants.title: Ohio Small Business Support Grants
grants.description: Grants provided to Ohio nonprofit organizations, businesses, schools, and individuals to support various community and business development initiatives.
grants.best_for: Small businesses and organizations based in Ohio.
